limits: Same root means numeric ModuleId, not a distinct project-path namespace. Filesystem projects commonly share root=0, so unrelated project stages or single-source Candidate entries can be conservatively evicted; this affects cache hit rate, not acceptance.
Old entries under other root IDs can remain. This policy is not a session-wide live-byte ceiling or byte-budgeted cache.
The release policy triggers only when modules+4 exceeds raw capacity. Large-capacity histories and parse-only/failed subsequent requests may have different retention or hit behavior.
